title: Opened on the computer
description: LINKS-1: the reply to `POST /v1/host/open {source, path | url, check?}`. Native and web credentials. `source` is `{kind: "agent", item: <agent row id>}` or `{kind: "herdr", pane: "w1:p2", session?: <this device's selected session>}`; `path` is the text exactly as it appeared (`/abs/x.md:12`, `~/x.png`, `./out.csv`, `out.csv`, `/a/b#L12`, a markdown target, `file://`), `url` an http(s) address exactly as it appeared (the original, not a client's rewrite). It must appear in that source: an assistant message's text or a tool row's `paths` for the Agent; the pane's visible screen now (line breaks taken out) for Herdr. A path resolves against the thread's or the pane's folder; its real path must be in `$HOME`, in that folder or in `/tmp` (outside `$HOME` only the user's own files); private places are refused first (`~/.ssh`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.codex`, `~/.claude`, Omodachi's config and state except uploads and the agent workspace, key and credential files, `.env`); only regular files and folders; never anything with an exec bit, an ELF binary, a `.desktop`, an AppImage or another launchable kind. Opened with the desktop's default handler (`xdg-open`), on the Remote session's output when one runs (`where: remote`), else on the computer's focused screen (`where: screen`); `check: true` opens nothing (`opened: false`, `where: null`). `line` is the `:12` / `#L12` the text carried; `at_line` says the editor was opened there (Omarchy's terminal editor through `omarchy-launch-editor`; any other default handler opens the file as usual). No byte of the file is in this reply. Refusals are http-error documents: `403 open_not_mentioned`, `403 open_outside_roots`, `403 open_denied`, `403 open_executable`, `404 open_missing`, `404 open_source_gone`, `415 open_type_refused`, `400 open_url_refused`, `429 open_rate_limited` (30 a minute per device), `503 open_unavailable` (no graphical session, or the handler failed). One journal line per request.
